asserts: on a lab node, the plugin's admission decision for a peer is exactly one of GO or NO, recorded in the node's own ledger, naming its source and the operator policy it read by digest; the verdict follows from its source as the plugin decides, and each base-policy row it seals is one the plugin's rules give from the reads it seals
detail: node stevenmih-1: 0 of 1728 ledger records carry an admission decision (0 GO, 0 NO), read-only; node stevenmih-2: 10 of 928 ledger records carry an admission decision (10 GO, 0 NO), read-only; node stevenmih-3: 26 of 1728 ledger records carry an admission decision (26 GO, 0 NO), read-only; of the base-policy rows sealed, 18 were fixed by the record and matched it, 72 are values the rules allow but the record does not fix (rows.json) and 0 disagree. Each decision is GO or NO, names its source, cites the operator policy it read by digest (or is a NO sealed with no readable policy), carries no member beyond the plugin's own and names the peer by commitment only; its verdict follows from its source alone, the same for one peer under one policy digest; each row it seals is one the base policy's rules give from what it read. The step read the ledger lines as written, without verifying their signatures. Spend: none; this step pays nothing (would spend 0 USD). Outside this step's assertion: each base-policy row's value where the sealed decision does not fix it: identity's fail or not_read on no card, key age on a cited card, and the three local rows: evidence-network/loop#81. Outside this step's assertion: each ledger record's producer signature and capsule_id: evidence-network/loop#135. Outside this step's assertion: the routing path enforcing the decision when it chooses a candidate: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm#2061.
